name: The House of Love
label: Creation Records
lede: Guy Chadwick built a band out of a Melody Maker ad and gave Creation an indie No. 1 with 'Christine'. Then came a major label, four producers and Terry Bickers setting fire to the band's money in the tour van.

eras.title: A Melody Maker ad in Camberwell
eras.text: Guy Chadwick was about 30, nearly a decade older than his lead guitarist, and his first band's RCA single was one he later called "dreadful". One Jesus and Mary Chain show sent him looking for a new group, and by May 1987 it had a single out on Creation Records.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: Guy Chadwick
years.h: One Jesus and Mary Chain show at the Electric Ballroom does it
years.p: Chadwick, ex-Kingdoms, comes out of a [[The Jesus and Mary Chain|e938a15c-b17e-4e7a-9f68-ff0d536cab44]] gig at Camden's Electric Ballroom wanting a band. He finds [[Terry Bickers|e5df3ca6-9180-46c9-902a-cf4a70c8640c]], lead guitarist of Northern Irish band [[Colenso Parade|8b17f61a-f803-481e-a5f7-1ad0be6b357f]].

years.h: A New Zealander answers the ad, a German joins on guitar
years.p: Bassist Chris Groothuizen comes through a Melody Maker ad, drummer Pete Evans is an old friend of Chadwick's, and Andrea Heukamp sings and plays rhythm guitar. The name comes off Anaïs Nin's novel A Spy in the House of Love.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: The House of Love (1988 album)
years.h: Shine On is the first House of Love record on Creation
years.p: The debut single. Neither it nor the follow-up, 'Real Animal', made the first album, and 'Shine On' would come back three years later as a hit.

years.h: A Town & Country Club show sells Creation on an album
years.p: After touring with [[Felt|6999f790-25f4-44a3-b745-1e3e01fde0f5]] and [[Zodiac Mindwarp|667c72f6-78dc-4a04-8755-d49448a3173f]], the band plays London's Town & Country Club to rave reviews, and Creation agrees to pay for a full record.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: The House of Love (1988 album)
years.h: Andrea Heukamp quits, tired of touring
years.p: The band carries on as a four-piece. Heukamp's eight songs with them turn up on a German release known as The German Album.
years.xp: Chadwick, years later: "Losing Andrea Heukamp was a massive, massive blow for me: I loved her voice and I loved her playing."

eras.title: Christine, then the majors come calling
eras.text: The first album took just over a week to record and a lot longer to mix. It topped the indie charts in Britain and Europe, and by the end of the year the band belonged to a PolyGram label, with Alan McGee still in the manager's chair.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love (1988 album)
years.h: 'Christine' goes to No. 1 on the indie chart
years.p: The single, with Heukamp's guitar and backing vocals still on it, arrives ahead of the album and tops the UK independent chart.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love (1988 album) · Wikipedia: The House of Love
yt: Live in Brighton, with an interview, on Snub TV, 1988
years.h: Recorded in a week, mixed in a fog
years.p: The untitled debut goes down in just over a week. The mixing is a fight, and producer [[Pat Collier|418a87fc-9c94-4704-bfe3-023e2a29adde]] ends up doing the final mix.
years.xp:
Wikipedia's account says the mix sessions involved "copious use of LSD" and enough disagreement inside the band that Collier was handed the job of finishing it.

Cherry Red later expanded it to three CDs in 2012 and five for the 30th anniversary.

years.h: 'Destroy the Heart' makes John Peel's Festive Fifty
years.p: [[John Peel|e4dec348-ad10-43b6-a2b1-c22aab890675]]'s listeners put the House of Love single in their year-end poll, the year the debut topped the European indie charts.

years.h: Fontana signs them away from Creation
years.p: The band moves to PolyGram's Fontana label, distributed by PolyGram in the US. McGee stays on as manager.

eras.title: Four producers and a fire in the van
eras.text: Two years, several studios and four producers went into the second album. Somewhere in the middle, Chadwick and Bickers stopped speaking, and Bickers was gone before the record came out.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: The House of Love (1990 album)
years.h: Fontana puts out 'Never' against the band's wishes
years.p: The first major-label single stalls at No. 41, just outside the Top 40.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love (1990 album) · Wikipedia: The House of Love
years.h: The man who signed Def Leppard picks their producers
years.p: Fontana's Dave Bates runs the band through [[Dave Meegan|11307138-0694-4729-bc6a-3d0b3893adb3]], Paul Staveley O'Duffy, [[Stephen Hague|fd17f7a3-c8e7-442f-a0b4-4f94a3d6f294]] and [[Tim Palmer|2322b9ca-c0b0-4c86-a58f-3c8dd73c208b]]. Chadwick, looking back in 2005, blamed the label and the band both.
years.xp:
Chadwick on Bates: he "had signed Def Leppard and Tears for Fears so he had a lot of clout. He insisted on putting us together with producers who were quite obviously wrong for us."

And on the band: "We were taking too many drugs, I was drinking ridiculously and that's the worst combination." The debut had taken a week; this one took two years across several studios.

years.cap: Chadwick at the ICA, London, June 5, 1989
years.h: A week at the ICA, with the Stone Roses in support
years.p: The band takes over London's Institute of Contemporary Arts for a week-long residency. The support acts include [[Pere Ubu|5a54b72e-bfb3-4ca6-944a-e17261399965]], [[The Stone Roses|b5fa29f1-6c22-4321-a488-b5f363b06b06]] and the Rainbirds.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: The House of Love (1990 album)
yt: 'I Don't Know Why I Love You', official video
years.h: Radio 1's Single of the Week stalls at No. 41 too
years.p: 'I Don't Know Why I Love You' gets the Radio 1 push and still misses the Top 40. A UK tour of more than 60 dates is booked to close the year.

q: I just found at the time that I didn't have the same aspirations
years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: Terry Bickers
years.h: Terry Bickers sets fire to the band's money in the van
years.p: Bickers chants it at Chadwick while burning the cash, a protest at what he saw as the band's turn toward money. He's out mid-tour; the official line is that he's resting from exhaustion.
years.xp:
By then Chadwick and Bickers weren't speaking at all. Bickers later put it down to frustration: "I was more into exploring music than exploring the exploitation of markets around the globe."

Accounts of his health at the time differ: the band's Wikipedia history and his own page describe different conditions. His guitar is still all over the second album.

years.h: Simon Walker plays his first show at Portsmouth Polytechnic
years.p: The replacement lead guitarist comes from My White Bedroom and the Dave Howard Singers, and steps straight into the rest of the tour.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love (1990 album) · Wikipedia: The House of Love
years.h: The Butterfly album reaches No. 8
years.p: Untitled again, it gets called the Butterfly album. A re-recorded 'Shine On' becomes the band's biggest UK hit at No. 20, and 'The Beatles and the Stones' follows into the Top 40 in April.
years.xp: Wikipedia puts worldwide sales above 400,000 copies, and the album spent eight weeks on the Billboard 200, peaking at No. 148. In March, 'I Don't Know Why I Love You', a No. 41 at home, reached No. 2 on Billboard's Modern Rock chart.

years.cap: Poster for the Royal Albert Hall, March 9, 1990
years.h: The tour ends with a sold-out Royal Albert Hall
years.p: The high-water mark: a band that started on Creation singles fills the Kensington hall.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: Terry Bickers
years.h: Bickers forms Levitation, and the feud goes to the music press
years.p: Chadwick claims he played "90 per cent" of the guitars on the records, and later withdraws it. Bickers, now fronting [[Levitation|83568734-6c31-48a2-a172-7cae468c52c3]], calls Chadwick "a megalomaniac".

years.h: The scrapped songs come out under the book's full title
years.p: A compilation of B-sides and material dropped during the long second-album sessions. The promo track 'Marble' reaches No. 5 on the US Modern Rock chart.

eras.title: Three gigs in one night, then nothing left
eras.text: With Walker on guitar the band played the Paris Olympia live on France Inter and kept the singles coming, but the hits didn't. By 1993 Chadwick was playing every guitar part himself, and when the drummer said he wanted out, the band ended.

years.cap: Ticket for the Town & Country Club leg, August 31, 1991
years.h: Three London gigs on the same night
years.p: The band plays the University of London Union, the Town & Country Club and the Boston Arms in Tufnell Park, one after another.

years.h: A Leonard Cohen cover for I'm Your Fan
years.p: The band records 'Who by Fire' for the 1991 [[Leonard Cohen|65314b12-0e08-43fa-ba33-baaa7b874c15]] tribute album. October's single 'The Girl with the Loneliest Eyes' misses the chart.

years.h: Walker leaves mid-sessions; ex-Woodentop Simon Mawby steps in
years.p: Six months of recording for the third album. Walker goes over musical differences, and Heukamp comes back as a studio guest on guitar and backing vocals.

years.h: Babe Rainbow gets the reviews and a No. 34
years.p: 'You Don't Understand' makes No. 9 on the US Modern Rock chart. On the road, the band shares a triple bill with [[Ocean Colour Scene|601d793d-7e96-4bb6-b4a6-712d5c926259]] and [[Catherine Wheel|37e3dd97-73f9-4c69-b50d-0c0e3c47c40c]]; Mawby leaves at year's end.

years.h: Done in under two weeks, gone from the chart in one
years.p: Chadwick plays all the guitars, and Groothuizen and Evans get songwriting credits for the first time. No singles; one week in the Top 40.

years.h: Pete Evans wants to retire, and Chadwick ends the band
years.p: Evans tells the others he's stopping after a French tour. Chadwick promotes the album alone, then, with only Groothuizen left and no drummer, disbands the House of Love.
years.xp:
Chadwick has been open about what came next: "It was very hard to get out of bed. I was ill... I just cracked up, and couldn't function for years."

He has said that living through it helped him understand what Bickers had gone through, and the two eventually made peace.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: Guy Chadwick
years.h: Chadwick goes solo with a Cocteau Twin producing
years.p: After the Madonnas (1994–95) and a Belgian project that released nothing, Chadwick's solo album is produced by [[Robin Guthrie|47d7b25e-585b-4c97-b98b-411b21a53379]] of [[Cocteau Twins|000fc734-b7e1-4a01-92d1-f544261b43f5]].

eras.title: Old enough and ugly enough
eras.text: A former agent talked Chadwick and Bickers back into a room, and this time it held for two albums. Groothuizen, by now an architect, stayed out of it. In 2007 they played the debut in full in the Don't Look Back series.

years.src: Wikipedia: The House of Love · Wikipedia: Terry Bickers
years.h: Chadwick and Bickers re-form the band
years.p: Former agent Mick Griffiths pushes for it, Evans comes back on drums, and Matt Jury takes Groothuizen's place on bass.

q: old enough and ugly enough to address any issues head-on
years.h: Days Run Away, on Art & Industry
years.p: The reunion album gets warm reviews and a tour of the UK, Ireland and Sweden. Chadwick calls the friendship "complex" and "always slightly fractious".

years.cap: Bickers and Chadwick at the Haunt, Brighton, April 2013
years.h: She Paints Words in Red comes out on Cherry Red
years.p: Chadwick, Bickers, Evans and Jury again. Two nights at the Lexington in London that year become a live album.

eras.title: Chadwick keeps the name
eras.text: Thirty years on from the debut, the band played it in full one more time. Then Chadwick hired a new line-up, and Bickers started something of his own with two old bandmates.

years.h: At the Roundhouse, they play the debut in full, minus one song
years.p: The 30th-anniversary show in London ends a six-date British tour. One track gets accidentally left out.

years.h: A new House of Love for the American dates
years.p: Chadwick announces guitarist Keith Osborne, bassist Harry Osborne and drummer Hugo Degenhardt, who has played with [[Bryan Ferry|4ef7a9e2-2cf5-483a-8616-ef7791a98026]] and [[Rod Stewart|a35237a0-4f47-40a6-b6f3-1e786db23402]].

years.h: A State of Grace, the first album in nine years
years.p: An 11-date UK tour follows, then the North American anniversary tour pushed back from 2020.

years.h: Andrea Heukamp dies in Münster at 57
years.p: The band's first guitarist had lived away from music for years, singing backing vocals with the Münster group Loving the Sun.

years.h: Bickers launches the Inner Spiral with Evans and Jury
years.p: Terry Bickers & the Inner Spiral puts the reunion-era rhythm section behind him. He has also taught music in Brighton and practised the martial art Shintaido since 1998.
